units.source_text: 宫中推算：到了夏天，赴三条宫邸的方向不利。

en.t: The court diviners calculated that once summer came, the direction toward the Sanjo residence would be unlucky.

units.source_text: 因此决定在四月初，未交立夏以前，叫二公主迁居三条宫邸。

en.t: It was therefore decided that the Second Princess would move to the Sanjo residence early in the fourth month, before the beginning of summer.

units.source_text: 迁居的前一天，今上来到藤壶院，举行一个送别的藤花宴。

en.t: On the day before the move, the Emperor came to Fujitsubo and held a farewell banquet beneath the wisteria blossoms.

units.source_text: 南面厢屋的帘子一律卷上，其中设置今上的御座。

en.t: All the blinds of the southern aisle were rolled up, and the Emperor's seat was prepared there.

units.source_text: 此宴会不由藤壶院的主人二公主做主，而是皇上举办的公宴。

en.t: This banquet was not hosted by the Second Princess, the mistress of Fujitsubo, but was an official feast given by the Emperor.

units.source_text: 故公卿王侯及殿上人的飨宴，均由宫中御厨供应。

en.t: Accordingly, the food for the nobles, princes, and courtiers was all supplied by the imperial kitchens.

units.source_text: 参与宴会的有夕雾左大臣、按察大纳言、已故髭黑大臣之子藤中纳言及其弟左兵卫督。

en.t: Those attending included Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, the Inspector Grand Counselor, To no Chujo, son of the late Minister Higekuro, and his younger brother, the Captain of the Left Division of Palace Guards.

units.source_text: 亲王之中有三皇子及其弟常陆亲王。

en.t: Among the princes were the Third Prince and his younger brother, Prince Hitachi.

units.source_text: 殿上人的座位设在南庭的藤花下面。

en.t: The courtiers' seats were arranged beneath the wisteria blossoms in the southern garden.

units.source_text: 宣召一班乐队，把他们安排在后凉殿东面。

en.t: A group of musicians was summoned and placed on the east side of the Koryoden.

units.source_text: 到了日暮，命乐人奏双调，殿上管弦之会就此开始。

en.t: At dusk, the musicians were ordered to play in the sojo mode, and the court concert began.

units.source_text: 二公主命人取出种种琴和笛来，从夕雾左大臣开始，诸公卿顺次将乐器奉献御前。

en.t: The Second Princess had various zithers and flutes brought out, and beginning with Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, the nobles presented the instruments one by one before the Emperor.

units.source_text: 已故六条院主亲笔书写而交付尼僧三公主的两卷琴谱，插上一枝五叶松，由薰大将呈上。

en.t: Two scrolls of zither music, written by the late Rokujo lord himself and given to the nun Third Princess, were adorned with a sprig of five-needle pine and presented by General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣接了，奉献御前。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, received them and offered them before the Emperor.

units.source_text: 接着顺次奉上琴、筝、琵琶、和琴等，都是朱雀院的遗物。

en.t: Next, zithers, the koto, a biwa, a wagon, and other instruments were presented in turn, all keepsakes of Suzaku院.

units.source_text: 笛是夕雾梦中得柏木告语而转赠与薰君的纪念物。

en.t: The flute was a keepsake that Yugiri had passed on to Lord Kaoru after hearing Kashiwagi speak to him in a dream.

units.source_text: 今上曾经赞赏此笛，说是“音色之美无比”。

en.t: The Emperor had once praised this flute, saying that the beauty of its tone was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 薰大将想：“除了今日的盛大宴会之外，何时更有良机呢？”

en.t: General Kaoru thought, What better occasion could there be than today's splendid banquet?

units.source_text: 因此取出这支笛来。

en.t: So he brought out that flute.

units.source_text: 于是夕雾左大臣奏和琴，三皇子奏琵琶，此外分赐诸人，开始演奏。

en.t: Then Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, played the wagon, the Third Prince played the biwa, other instruments were assigned to the rest, and the performance began.

units.source_text: 薰大将的笛，今日尽情地吹出盖世无双的美音。

en.t: General Kaoru's flute poured forth its peerless beautiful sound to the full that day.

units.source_text: 殿上人中，几个善歌的人也都应召而出，演唱非常美妙的歌曲。

en.t: Among the courtiers, several skilled singers were also summoned and sang songs of extraordinary beauty.

units.source_text: 二公主命人取点心，盛在四只沉香木制的食盒里，载在紫檀木制的高脚木盘上。

en.t: The Second Princess had refreshments brought in, placed in four aloeswood food boxes, and set on high trays made of red sandalwood.

units.source_text: 衬布染成紫藤色，深浅有致，上面绣着藤花折枝。

en.t: The lining cloths were dyed wisteria purple in pleasing gradations of light and dark, with sprays of wisteria blossoms embroidered on them.

units.source_text: 白银的酒器、琉璃的杯子、深蓝琉璃的瓶子，概由左兵卫督一手置办。

en.t: The silver sake vessels, glass cups, and deep blue glass bottles had all been arranged personally by the Captain of the Left Division of Palace Guards.

units.source_text: 今上赐酒一杯，夕雾左大臣受赐已多，今日不好意思接受。

en.t: When the Emperor bestowed a cup of wine, Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, having already received many favors, felt unable to accept it that day.

units.source_text: 而亲王之中又无适当之人可以转让，便转让给薰大将。

en.t: Since there was no suitable prince to whom he could pass it, he passed it on to General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 薰大将意欲辞退，但恐今上不悦，便接了酒杯，唱一声警跸。

en.t: General Kaoru wished to decline, but fearing the Emperor's displeasure, he accepted the cup and gave a ceremonial cry of warning.

units.source_text: 其声音与姿态，原与普通仪式中无异，然而似觉特别优美，与众不同。

en.t: His voice and bearing were no different from those of an ordinary ceremony, yet somehow they seemed especially beautiful and unlike anyone else's.

units.source_text: 大约由于今日他是天之骄子，所以看来更增光彩吧。

en.t: Perhaps because on this day he seemed favored by heaven, he appeared all the more radiant.

units.source_text: 薰大将把酒倾入另一瓷杯，怀藏了天子所赐的酒杯，然后喝干了酒，归还了瓷杯，下阶拜舞谢恩。

en.t: General Kaoru poured the wine into another porcelain cup, tucked away the cup bestowed by the Emperor, then drank the wine dry, returned the porcelain cup, descended the steps, and performed the dance of thanks.

units.source_text: 其姿态优美无比。

en.t: His bearing was beautiful beyond compare.

units.source_text: 地位尊贵的亲王及大臣蒙天子赐酒，尚且引为莫大之荣幸，何况薰大将以驸马身份受此恩宠，实乃世间稀有之珍闻。

en.t: Even high-ranking princes and ministers regarded receiving wine from the Emperor as an immense honor, so for General Kaoru to receive such favor as the Emperor's son-in-law was truly a rare marvel in the world.

units.source_text: 然而地位高下毕竟都有规定，薰大将拜舞之后只得退归末座，旁人看来实在委屈了他。

en.t: Yet the ranks of high and low were fixed after all, and after his dance of thanks General Kaoru had no choice but to withdraw to the lowest seat, which seemed a real slight to those watching.
